history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead as far as the network goes.

I can help you troubleshoot this issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for the information. Your account and line are both active, so let's start troubleshooting your phone's network issue.

To proceed, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help determine if Airplane Mode is on, if there's a SIM issue, or if there's no signal detected.
At the top of my screen I see the Airplane Mode icon, a 'No Signal' icon, and 'Data Enabled.' There are no signal bars showing.

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including cellular service. This is likely the reason you have no service or signal.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your device. Once you do, check if your signal bars return and if you can use your phone normally. Let me know what you see after turning Airplane Mode off.
Airplane mode is now off, but I still don't see any signal bars and there's still no service.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. This will help us determine if your phone is detecting the SIM card properly.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your device and let me know if it shows as active, missing, or locked? If you need instructions on how to check this, let me know your phone model and I can guide you.
My SIM card status shows as active.

Thank you for confirming that your SIM card is active. Since Airplane Mode is off and your SIM is active, but you still have no signal, let's try reseating your SIM card. This can help resolve any temporary connection issues.

Please remove your SIM card from your phone, wait a few seconds, and then reinsert it securely. After doing this, check if your phone regains signal or shows any bars. Let me know the result.
I removed and reinserted the SIM card. The SIM status is still active, but I still have no signal bars and no service.

Thank you for trying that. Since your SIM card is active and properly seated, but you still have no signal, the next step is to check your network mode settings. Sometimes, if your phone is set to use an unsupported network mode (like 2G/3G only), it may not connect properly.

Please check your phone’s network mode preference and let me know what it is currently set to (e.g., 5G, 4G, 3G, 2G, etc.). If you need instructions on how to check this, let me know your phone model.
My phone's network mode preference is currently set to 5G/4G/3G/2G (auto connect).

Thank you for checking your network mode preference. Since it is set to auto-connect across all available networks (which is correct), and your SIM is active but you still have no signal, let's check your Access Point Name (APN) settings next. Incorrect APN settings can sometimes cause a complete loss of service.

Please check your APN settings and let me know the APN name and MMSC URL that are currently set on your device. If you need help finding this information, let me know your phone model and I can guide you.
I checked my APN settings. The APN name is 'fast.telecom.net', the status says 'Not set', and the MMSC URL is 'http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc'.

Thank you for providing your APN details. The APN name is set, but the status says "Not set," which could indicate an incomplete or incorrect configuration. This can definitely cause a loss of service.

Let’s try resetting your APN settings to the default values. Please reset your APN settings on your device, then restart your phone. After restarting, check if you have signal bars or service.

Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you still have no service after resetting and restarting.
I reset the APN settings to default, and after restarting my phone, I still have no signal bars and no service. The issue hasn't changed.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular service: no signal bars, no service, and cannot send MMS. Troubleshooting steps completed: Airplane Mode off, SIM active and reseated, network mode correct, APN reset, device restarted. Issue persists. Needs advanced technical support.
